print_errors.note: Prayer ٤٦ prints وَآلَهُ (fatha on lam, damma on ha) where وَآلِهِ is expected. Kept as printed.

notes: p.137 starts a new numbered prayer (٤٦); p.136 ends with a full stop, so there is no '+'. pp.138, 139 and 140 continue the sentence from the previous page ('+'). On p.138→139 the verse ﴿وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ is split by the page turn. The print has only the opening bracket on p.138 and only the closing bracket on p.139. To pass validate.py's per-line balance check, I closed it after وَإِنَّكَ on p.138 and reopened it before لَتَهْدِىٓ on p.139, the way poetry fences are handled across pages. The verse quotations on these pages have no ayah-number ornaments, so none are written. Many commas are printed with no space before the next word (e.g. «وَعِلْمًا،فَوَسِعَ»); I wrote one space after each comma. In the opening formula, سَيِّدِنا is printed without a fatha on the nun in prayers ٤٦-٤٨ (p.137) and with one (سَيِّدِنَا) in prayers ٤٩-٥٣; each is copied as printed. Silent alifs in Quran (ءَامَنُوا۟، تُوَلُّوا۟) are written with U+06DF to match the Tanzil encoding used in earlier batches.
